query:
SELECT to_jsonb(t) || jsonb_build_object('visibility', m.visibility) AS "state!: Json<ThreadState>" FROM comms_message_threads t JOIN comms_messages m ON m.id = t.root_id
               WHERE t.root_id = $1 AND t.parent_entity_type = $2 AND t.parent_entity_id = $3
                   AND t.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE OF t
